name: Hourly energy dispatch and diesel start/stop
covers: V5 rebuilt PV rack geometry and no protruding center frame
PV DC into inverter and inverter AC into LV switchgear
description: Moving the 24h scrubber updates measured-input-derived modeled solar power, battery SOC and diesel supply with power in kW.
steps: Open the 3D Experience and find the hourly weather and dispatch model panel
Move the hour slider to 12:00 on June 15 and note PV available and diesel status
Move the hour slider to 00:00
Confirm the MODEL AVG card reads 9.27 hours/day and the 15 Jun selected-day card reads 11 hours/day at 165 kVA, PF 0.90
Inspect PV rows from close-up and verify there is no tall central object protruding through panel faces.
At 12:00 June 15 verify independent PV DC and inverter AC animated paths enter inverter and LV respectively. Diesel remains idle.
At 00:00 confirm PV DC and inverter AC are idle and diesel feeds switchgear and ESP VSD.
expected: At midnight PV AVAILABLE is 0 kW, diesel supply is ON and the power-balance total equals 148.5 kW, with the battery SOC displayed. The 304 kWp base simulation shows 3385 yearly off hours, 9.27 h/day average, 11 h off on 15 June. PV field displays consistent shallow tilt and realistic supports. PV flow directions follow SLD and never reverse on diesel operation.

name: Change normal ESP load and verify energy balances
description: Pump load adjustment changes delivered real power and operating hours and can reset.
steps: At the mobile-size technical panel move ESP load from 165 to 210 kVA
Check active electrical load reads 189.0 kW at PF 0.90 and the DG-off annual-hours result updates
Click Reset technical assumptions
Confirm modeled generator-off average recalculates with the higher pump load before reset
expected: The displayed ESP load is again 165 kVA and 148.5 kW, and no power or SOC labels are blank or negative.

name: Design 456kWp vendor comparison and separation from finance
covers: One-piece solar modules and complete inverter count switch
description: Switch to supplier design without mixing equipment scope and the 304kWp economic CAPEX.
steps: Record CAPEX, IRR and payback shown in the economics dashboard
Change the Design basis selector to supplier
Read PV annual gross MWh, BESS battery size, and design warning
Inspect 702 flat modules and all three PV inverters in supplier mode, then 468 modules and only two complete inverter units in financial mode.
expected: The 456 kWp / 483.9 kWh supplier design appears, its modelled annual PV exceeds 900 MWh, and the financial KPIs remain based on the 304 kWp reference.

name: Weather month change and manual finance screening sensitivity
description: Changing date changes representative hourly PV; finance can be manually updated only for matching 304 kWp reference.
steps: Change Climate Month from June to December and select day 15
Check that the 24h source chart and irradiance change
Return design to feasibility if needed and click Apply modelled off-hours to economic sensitivity
Change design to supplier
expected: Month selection and chart update, and the economic panel responds to the applied 304 kWp screening scenario; apply button is disabled in supplier mode.

name: V9 desert-ground realism, no rectangular PV pad, responsive aerial and side views
covers: Continuous sand ground under all PV modules
Cinematic tour and site camera presets unaffected
No changes to dispatch or economics
description: Visual regression for removing the artificial 112x83 ground slab and enhancing the 3D industrial desert environment.
steps: Open 3D on iPhone-sized viewport. Select AERIAL view, then orbit the PV array: ground under panels and around the perimeter must be one seamless sand material with no pale rectangular pad.
Inspect SOLAR PV from a low side angle: no opaque ground plane, no row-sized white bars or floating frames. Galvanized support legs remain beneath uniform blue modules.
Inspect POWER ROOM and DIESEL: nearby gravel access area reads as desert with narrow tire tracks, not a giant concrete platform; realistic rocks only appear outside equipment area.
At solar noon, generator and batteries are readable with brighter sunlight and natural equipment shadow contrast.
Start CINEMATIC TOUR and visit all camera presets, then stop. Controls remain functional.
Switch financial 304kWp (468 modules) and supplier 456kWp (702 modules); check installed PV count and electric logic.
Change hour and ESP load and verify numeric operating output, energy flow, economics and 5.5 h financial reference remain unchanged.
expected: No giant pale rectangle under solar field, natural continuous textured sand with gentle terrain relief, good day/night readability, all prior interaction and simulation behavior preserved.
